summary: Terra Property Trust (issuer) filed an 8-K on 6/29/2026 reporting completion of an exchange offer for its outstanding 6.00% Senior Notes due 2026. $36.2M of TPTA notes were tendered; $27.2M in new 11.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 plus cash were issued. Remaining untendered notes were repaid. The new notes are senior secured, pari passu with existing secured notes, and governed by an indenture with U.S. Bank Trustee. This is a liability management restructuring to extend maturities at a higher coupon. Watch for any subsequent debt refinancing or potential liquidity strain given the elevated interest cost.
